title: Applicant Admin
description: Track a submitted application and manage the next steps after approval.

stages.label: Member Review
stages.description: The plan administrator reviews membership status and eligibility information.

stages.label: Underwriting
stages.description: The New York Life team reviews detailed records, including financial and medical information when required.

stages.label: Final Decision Status
stages.description: The applicant receives the final decision. Once approved, the member receives a welcome kit and more information about their coverage.
